Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGUV$CHK_VVC_PK */
PROCEDURE CGUV$CHK_VVC_PK(
 P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_VIN_CD IN NUMBER) IS /* Item value */
/* Check uniqueness against primary/unique constraint */
/* Note : NO_DATA_FOUND exception handled by calling trigger */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 WHERE VIN_CD = P_VIN_CD
 AND PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGUV$CHK_VVC_UK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGUV$CHK_VVC_UK */
PROCEDURE CGUV$CHK_VVC_UK(
 P_CHASE_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Item value */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_VIN_CD IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.VIN_CD. */
 ,P_RECORD_STATUS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* The ROWID */
/* Check uniqueness against primary/unique constraint */
/* Note : NO_DATA_FOUND exception handled by calling trigger */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 IF (P_RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT') THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 WHERE CHASE_NBR = P_CHASE_NBR;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 WHERE CHASE_NBR = P_CHASE_NBR
 AND P_VIN_CD != VIN_CD
 AND P_PORT_CD != PORT_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VVC_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Vin Cd,Port Cd' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VVC_UK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم الشاسيه' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VIN_ADD_VCARD_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VIN_ADD_VCARD_old IS


V_VIN_CD NUMBER ;
V_VIN_LIST VARCHAR2(4000);
V_LOC NUMBER ;

V_CNT_RECORD NUMBER ;
V_SELECT_RECORD NUMBER := 0 ;

V_CHASE_NBR VARCHAR2(50);
V_ENGINE_NBR VARCHAR2(50);
V_PRODCT_YR NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_1 NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_2 NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_3 NUMBER;
V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR NUMBER ;
V_CARD_NBR NUMBER ;
V_CARD_DATE DATE ;
V_GDATE DATE ;
V_CARD_ISU_YEAR NUMBER ;
V_CUSTOM_DUTY NUMBER ;
V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER ;


BEGIN

 GO_BLOCK('VHCL_VIN_CARDS');

 LAST_RECORD;
 V_CNT_RECORD := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 IF :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.CHASE_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.SELECT = 1 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT( '1','ERROR');

 V_VIN_CD := :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.VIN_CD ;
 V_SELECT_RECORD := V_SELECT_RECORD + 1 ;
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT CHASE_NBR,ENGINE_NBR ,PRODCT_YR ,COLOR_CD_1,COLOR_CD_2,COLOR_CD_3,SPCFC_SEQ_NBR
 INTO V_CHASE_NBR,V_ENGINE_NBR ,V_PRODCT_YR ,V_COLOR_CD_1,V_COLOR_CD_2,V_COLOR_CD_3 ,V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR
 FROM VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 WHERE VIN_CD = V_VIN_CD ;

 SELECT VCARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL
 INTO V_CARD_NBR
 FROM SYS.DUAL;

 V_CARD_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;

 HIJDATE.TO_GREG(V_CARD_DATE,V_GDATE);
 V_CARD_ISU_YEAR := SUBSTR(V_GDATE ,3, 2);

 V_CUSTOM_DUTY := TRUNC(:PARAMETER.P_ORGNL_DUTY / :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_QTY ) ;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_QTY = V_SELECT_RECORD THEN
 V_CUSTOM_DUTY := :PARAMETER.P_ORGNL_DUTY - (TRUNC(:PARAMETER.P_ORGNL_DUTY / :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_QTY) * (V_SELECT_RECORD-1));
 END IF;

 --- INSERT DATA --------------
 BEGIN

 --STR.DISPALERT( '2','ERROR');

 INSERT INTO VHCL_CARDS ( PORT_CD, VHCL_CARD_NBR, VHCL_CARD_DT, CHASE_NBR, ENGINE_NBR, PRODCT_YR,
 COLOR_CD_1, COLOR_CD_2, COLOR_CD_3, VHCL_STATUS, SPCFC_SEQ_NBR, DCLTN_ISN, DCLTN_ITEM_ISN,
 ISU_USR, DCLTN_TYPE,CARD_ISU_YEAR, CUSTOM_DUTY,
 REC_STATUS, AUTO_CREATE , PRNT_NUM ) VALUES (
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ,V_CARD_NBR ,V_CARD_DATE,V_CHASE_NBR,V_ENGINE_NBR ,V_PRODCT_YR ,
 V_COLOR_CD_1,V_COLOR_CD_2,V_COLOR_CD_3,1,V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR ,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN , :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_ISN ,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD , V_CARD_ISU_YEAR , V_CUSTOM_DUTY ,
 1,1 , 0 );

 UPDATE VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 SET VC_CREATE = 1
 WHERE VIN_CD = V_VIN_CD ;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(7, 6, 1, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ||'!'||V_CARD_NBR||'!'||V_CARD_DATE)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN

 STR.DISPALERT( 'حدث خطأ أثناء أضافة بطاقة جمركية آليا , رقم البطاقة -- '|| V_CHASE_NBR ||' -- ERROR ->'||DBMS_ERROR_TEXT ,'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN ;
 END ;

 --------------------------------------------------------------

 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = V_CNT_RECORD;
 NEXT_RECORD;

 END LOOP;


 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 STR.DISPALERT( 'تم تكوين البطاقات الجمركية بنجاح','INFORMATION');

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'حدث خطا عام عند أضافة البطاقة الجمركية -- '|| V_CHASE_NBR ||' -- ERROR ->'||DBMS_ERROR_TEXT ,'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(null);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:

PROCEDURE vin_add_vcard
IS
 v_vin_cd NUMBER;

 v_loc NUMBER;
 v_cnt_record NUMBER;
 v_select_record NUMBER := 0;
 v_chase_nbr VARCHAR2 (50);

 v_prodct_yr NUMBER;
 v_color_cd_1 NUMBER;
 v_color_cd_2 NUMBER;
 v_color_cd_3 NUMBER;
 v_spcfc_seq_nbr NUMBER;
 v_card_nbr NUMBER;
 v_card_date DATE;
 v_gdate DATE;
 v_card_isu_year NUMBER;
 v_custom_duty NUMBER;
 v_msg_level NUMBER;
v_old_cards NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK ('VHCL_VIN_CARDS');
 LAST_RECORD;
 v_cnt_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 v_custom_duty := TRUNC (:parameter.p_orgnl_duty / :parameter.p_item_qty);

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_old_cards /* the old cards assigned duty */
 FROM vhcl_cards
 WHERE dcltn_item_isn = :parameter.p_item_isn
 AND custom_duty IS NULL ;

/* update the old cards with the new value after update the qty in dcltn items */
 UPDATE vhcl_cards
 SET custom_duty = v_custom_duty
 WHERE dcltn_item_isn = :parameter.p_item_isn AND custom_duty IS NULL;

 LOOP
 IF :vhcl_vin_cards.chase_nbr IS NOT NULL AND :vhcl_vin_cards.select = 1
 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT( '1','ERROR');
 v_vin_cd := :vhcl_vin_cards.vin_cd;
 v_select_record := v_select_record + 1;

--------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT chase_nbr, engine_nbr, prodct_yr, color_cd_1,
 color_cd_2, color_cd_3, spcfc_seq_nbr
 INTO v_chase_nbr, v_engine_nbr, v_prodct_yr, v_color_cd_1,
 v_color_cd_2, v_color_cd_3, v_spcfc_seq_nbr
 FROM vhcl_vin_cards
 WHERE vin_cd = v_vin_cd;

 SELECT vcard_seq.NEXTVAL
 INTO v_card_nbr
 FROM SYS.DUAL;

 v_card_date := hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 hijdate.to_greg (v_card_date, v_gdate);
 v_card_isu_year := SUBSTR (v_gdate, 3, 2);

 IF :parameter.p_item_qty = v_select_record
 THEN
 v_custom_duty :=
 :parameter.p_orgnl_duty
 - (
 (v_custom_duty * (v_select_record - 1)) + (v_custom_duty * v_old_cards )
 );
 END IF;

 --- INSERT DATA --------------
 BEGIN
 --STR.DISPALERT( '2','ERROR'); --
 INSERT INTO vhcl_cards
 (port_cd, vhcl_card_nbr, vhcl_card_dt,
 chase_nbr, engine_nbr, prodct_yr,
 color_cd_1, color_cd_2, color_cd_3, vhcl_status,
 spcfc_seq_nbr, dcltn_isn,
 dcltn_item_isn, isu_usr,
 dcltn_type, card_isu_year,
 custom_duty, rec_status, auto_create, prnt_num
 )
 VALUES (:parameter.p_curr_port_cd, v_card_nbr, v_card_date,
 v_chase_nbr, v_engine_nbr, v_prodct_yr,
 v_color_cd_1, v_color_cd_2, v_color_cd_3, 1,
 v_spcfc_seq_nbr, :parameter.p_dcltn_isn,
 :parameter.p_item_isn, :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.p_dcltn_type_cd, v_card_isu_year,
 v_custom_duty, 1, 1, 0
 );

 UPDATE vhcl_vin_cards
 SET vc_create = 1
 WHERE vin_cd = v_vin_cd;

 IF NOT activity.add_activity (7,
 6,
 1,
 :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_card_nbr
 || '!'
 || v_card_date
 )
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ( 'حدث خطأ أثناء أضافة بطاقة جمركية آليا , رقم البطاقة -- '
 || v_chase_nbr
 || ' -- ERROR ->'
 || DBMS_ERROR_TEXT,
 'ERROR'
 );
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 RETURN;
 END;
--------------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.cursor_record = v_cnt_record;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 v_msg_level := TO_NUMBER (NAME_IN ('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY (25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 COPY (v_msg_level, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 str.dispalert ('تم تكوين البطاقات الجمركية بنجاح', 'INFORMATION');
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 str.dispalert ( 'حدث خطا عام عند أضافة البطاقة الجمركية -- '
 || v_chase_nbr
 || ' -- ERROR ->'
 || DBMS_ERROR_TEXT,
 'ERROR'
 );
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COPY_SELECTED_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE copy_selected_values
IS
 msg_lvl VARCHAR2 (5);
 v_cnt_record NUMBER;
 v_vin_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_sta_cd
 INTO v_dcltn_sta_cd
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_dcltn_sta_cd IN (5, 9)
 THEN
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '25';
 GO_BLOCK ('VHCL_VIN_CARDS');
 LAST_RECORD;
 v_cnt_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 IF :vhcl_vin_cards.chase_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND :vhcl_vin_cards.select = 1
 THEN
 v_vin_cnt := v_vin_cnt + 1;
 --:GLOBAL.VIN_CHASE_LIST :=:GLOBAL.VIN_CHASE_LIST ||:VHCL_VIN_CARDS.VIN_CD||'#';
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.cursor_record = v_cnt_record;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 check_invoices;

 IF v_vin_cnt > 0 AND :parameter.p_price_unit = 0
 THEN
 --IF V_VIN_CNT <> :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_QTY THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT( ' كمية الصنف لا تساوي عدد السيارات المختاره من القائمة ','ERROR');
 -- RETURN ;
 --ELSE
 IF str.dispalert
 ('سوف يتم تكوين بطاقات جمركية لهذا الصنف , هل تريد الأستمرار',
 'WARNING'
 ) = alert_button1
 THEN
 vin_add_vcard;
 END IF;
 --END IF;
 END IF;

 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 :SYSTEM.message_level := msg_lvl;

 ELSE
 str.dispalert
 ('لن يتم إصدار بطاقات جمركية الا بعد تسديد البيان الجمركي',
 'error'
 );

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INVOICES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_INVOICES IS
V_CNT_RECORD NUMBER;
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_INV_QTY NUMBER;
V_VC_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN

 GO_BLOCK('VHCL_VIN_CARDS');

 LAST_RECORD;
 V_CNT_RECORD := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 IF :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.CHASE_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.SELECT = 1 THEN
 SELECT INV_QTY INTO V_INV_QTY FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND ITEM_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_ISN
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_VC_COUNT FROM VHCL_CARDS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_ITEM_ISN
 ;

 IF V_INV_QTY = V_VC_COUNT THEN

 STR.DISPALERT( 'تم أصدار بطاقات جمركيه على جميع فواتير هذا الصنف','ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN ;

 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN = :PARAMETER.INVO_ISN
 AND (INV_NBR <> :INVOICE_NBR OR INV_DATE <> :INVOICE_DT )
 ;
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = V_CNT_RECORD;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'توجد أرقام فواتير وتاريخهم غير متطابقه مع فواتير وتاريخ البيان ','ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASIGN_CHASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE asign_chases IS

V_VIN_COUNT NUMBER := 0 ;
V_VIN_CD VARCHAR2(100) := '';
V_ALL_CHASE_LIST VARCHAR2(4000) := '';
V_LOC NUMBER ;
V_CNT_RECORD NUMBER ;

BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.VIN_CNT > 0 THEN
 V_VIN_COUNT := :GLOBAL.VIN_CNT ;
 V_ALL_CHASE_LIST := :GLOBAL.VIN_CHASE_LIST ;

 FOR I IN 1..V_VIN_COUNT
 LOOP
 V_LOC := INSTR(V_ALL_CHASE_LIST,'#');
 V_VIN_CD := SUBSTR(V_ALL_CHASE_LIST,1,V_LOC-1);
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 LAST_RECORD;
 V_CNT_RECORD := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 IF :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.VIN_CD = V_VIN_CD THEN
 :VHCL_VIN_CARDS.SELECT :=1 ;
 --Set_Item_Instance_Property( 'VHCL_VIN_CARDS.CHASE_NBR', CURRENT_RECORD, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'r0g100b50');
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = V_CNT_RECORD;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 V_ALL_CHASE_LIST := SUBSTR(V_ALL_CHASE_LIST,V_LOC+1);

 END LOOP;

 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
